question: How will quarter to eight be indicated in the 24-hour format?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****Quarter to eight repres
ents quarter remaining from eight.**

Quarter to eight will be represented on the clock as:

Querter in a hour means = 60/4 = 15 Minutes.

And, 08:00 - 0:15 = 7:45 PM 

In 24 hours format: 7 hours after 12 PM will be written as 19 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4db42ad0dc8e9454dfb8b8cd60982b43c36c849221e5782e3f15e9bea1f3d65.png] 

Thus, the time will be 19:45 hours.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (1).**
